question: How a set that changes several files is applied

routes.reasoning_given: Only OS errors during the write itself remain
routes.route: Compute and verify every file first, then write each; nothing is written if any check fails

routes.reasoning_given: Refusing contradicted the contract rule that only required bytes change; rollback keeps the set all-or-nothing
routes.route: Refuse multi-file sets, reworked within step 1 to: verify all, write each atomically, roll back on failure, and name any file that could not be restored
